name: first run, plain tum_iqp, stock 18 Hz loop
hypothesis: Reproduce run_iros_08 (11 clean laps, 10.25-10.5 s) on the line believed to be the one it used.
verdict: FAILED: contact on lap 3 at the bottom hairpin (C1, s 5.9), understeer at steering lock with localization at 3-6 cm. Target speed there 2.2 m/s: this CSV plans a_lat 7.3 in both hairpins; run_iros_08 in fact followed a hairpin-capped z profile (apex 1.90). Recovery then looped (no checkpoints known for iros2026). Stopped manually.
verdict_short: FAIL - C1 understeer, wrong profile (not the run_iros_08 one)
